SOURCES SOUGHT SYNOPSIS
The Department of Veterans Affairs, Network Contracting Office 8 (NCO 8) is issuing this sources sought synopsis as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to provide HVAC services by factory certified technicians for Water-Cooled & Air-Cooled Chillers at the following Orlando VA Healthcare System (VAHCS) facilities:  Orlando VA Medical Center (VAMC) located in Orlando, FL; Lake Baldwin VA Medical Center (VAMC) located in Orlando, FL; Lakemont Campus located in Orlando, FL and Viera VA Healthcare Center (VAHCC) located in Viera, FL. 
Scope:  
The Contractor shall provide preventive maintenance, repair services, or comprehensive (all-inclusive parts & labor) preventive maintenance & repair services program or equivalent for Water-Cooled & Air-Cooled Chillers, in accordance with OEM specifications and recommendations, to preserve and enhance system reliability, improve efficiency, and extend equipment life.  In addition, cooling tower maintenance, eddy current testing, and chiller overhaul services may be performed on an as needed basis.  The list of equipment includes:

The results of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to this procurement is 238220   HVAC contractors.  The size standard is $19,000,000.00.

If your organization has the potential capacity to perform these contract services, please provide the following information: 
Organization name, address, telephone number, & email.
SAM UEI #.
Federal Supply Schedule #, if applicable.
Socio-Economic Category (SDVOSB, VOSB, WOSB, SB, Other, etc..).
Web site address (if applicable).
Provide a tailored capability statement addressing:
Relevant experience.
Services and equipment included.
Services and equipment excluded.
List the number of certified CVHE / CVHF Centrifugal Chiller technicians you employ.
List any discount payment terms you may offer (e.g. 1% -10, Net 30).
Provide possible warranty information.
If subcontracting or teaming is anticipated to deliver technical capability, organizations shall address the administrative and management structure of such arrangements. 

The government will evaluate market information to ascertain potential market capacity to provide services consistent in scope and scale with those described in this notice and otherwise anticipated.

BASED ON THE RESPONSES TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE/MARKET RESEARCH, THIS REQUIREMENT MAY BE SET-ASIDE, SOLE SOURCED, OR PROCURED THROUGH FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION.  Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding their submissions.

Submission Instructions: Interested parties who consider themselves qualified to perform the above-listed services are invited to submit a response to this Sources Sought Notice by 11:00 am (EST) on April 1, 2026.  All responses under this Sources Sought Notice must be emailed to Kurt.Kramer@va.gov.
